name: Octyldodecyl myristate
description: Octyldodecyl myristate (CAS 22766-83-2 ), also marketed as Hest ODM and Pelemol 2014, is a branched-chain ester used as an emollient and skin-conditioning agent in cosmetic formulations. It provides a lightweight, non-greasy skin feel while improving the spreadability and texture of finished products. In skincare, it functions as a carrier for active ingredients in serums, moisturizers, and treatment creams, improving delivery and sensory performance. Color cosmetics formulators use it to disperse pigments and achieve smooth, even application in foundations and lipsticks. It also acts as a co-solvent in sunscreen formulations, helping to dissolve UV filters and improve their compatibility within the oil phase. Hair care products such as conditioning treatments and styling preparations incorporate it to impart softness without heavy residue. Octyldodecyl myristate is supplied as a clear, pale liquid suitable for direct incorporation into oil phases. It is available in cosmetic-grade specification, meeting purity standards expected for personal care raw materials. Packaging options typically include drums and IBCs to accommodate both development-scale and commercial production volumes.
